subject: Proposed Waste and Recycling Service Changes
overview: The city held a virtual workshop to present and gather resident feedback on proposed changes for the upcoming 2024 solid waste and recycling contract. Proposed shifts included a move to weekly composting and every-other-week trash collection, alongside new fees for bulky item disposal.

items.title: Introductions and Workshop Overview
items.summary: Alicia Hunt and Jeremy Drake introduced the project goals, focusing on modernizing Medford's waste management and reducing incineration as the current contract ends.

items.title: Participant Polls
items.summary: Attendees identified their housing types and indicated preliminary interest in bi-weekly trash collection provided it was accompanied by weekly food scrap collection.

items.title: Current Waste Disposal Analysis
items.summary: Consultants presented data showing Medford has high trash disposal rates compared to neighboring communities and noted that nearly half of the city's current trash is actually recyclable or compostable.

items.title: Basic Services and Collection Frequency
items.summary: The city proposed weekly food waste collection and every-other-week trash disposal; breakout groups highlighted the need for public education and the specific challenges of disposing of diapers.

items.title: Bulky Items and Cost-Sharing
items.summary: Officials proposed a $5 minimum fee for bulky item pickups to leverage state funding, while residents suggested seasonal free drop-off events and a permanent 'reuse shed' for items like furniture.

items.title: Additional Services and Hazardous Waste
items.summary: Participants discussed strategies for handling mattresses and textiles under new state bans and prioritized the creation of a centralized 'Center for Hard to Recycle Materials' (CHARM) for electronics and hazardous waste.

items.title: Next Steps and Project Timeline
items.summary: The city announced a December 6 deadline for public comment, with a new request for proposals planned for early 2023 and new services anticipated to begin in July 2024.
